race.comment: TEE EIGHT (8) was highly impressive two back over 2000m at Murray Bridge, stoking up late to grab second in a BM56. Went back again last start and was too bad to be true over 2200m at Balaklava. Callow goes on which might spark a response. Deserves another chance. Veteran EAGLELOU (3) returned to form last time out, making late inroads to get up for fourth in the same race as TEE EIGHT at Balaklava. Should be finding the line well again. Greybeard MAGNETIC EDGE (5) kept finding to get up for third at his latest appearance over 2050m at Strathalbyn. In the mix at start number 113. GIRLS GIRLS GIRLS (9) was 32 days between runs when a closing second over 2200m at Balaklava recently, beating home a few of today's key rivals. Fitter and looks a big chance on face value but two wins in 32 dampens the enthusiasm. TURNED LOOSE (11) hasn't won in ages but with the light weight can sneak into the top four.
